metcon.name: Partner workout
metcon.description:
Guest programmer Shane
Partner Workout (teams of 3)
1 person working
1 person holding
1 person resting.
*Reps only count when position is held*
5 x 7min AMRAPs
2 mins rest between. This is also the workout/equipment reset time.
1. 7min AMRAP
50 Cal Row/35 Cal Bike
50 Wall Balls
Max DB Clean & Jerk @22.5/15
*Plank hold*
2. 7min AMRAP
100 Bar Over Hops (Double unders if space allows)
50 KB OH swings @24/16
Max Power snatch @40/30
*Wall Sit Hold*
3. 7min AMRAP
200m Run - All
60 Pull Ups
Max Thrusters @40/30
*DB Goblet Squat Hold*
4. 7min AMRAP
50 T2B
50 Burpees
Max Wall Walks
*Plate Hold OH @15/10*
5. 7min AMRAP
100 Lunges
50 HSPU/ HR Push Up
Max Devils Press @22.5/15
*Hold Top of Push Up*
Notes
-Only one DB used.
-"Holder" must be holding before movements count.
-Partners swap in/out as they see fit.
-Score is only the max effort reps. All preceding reps are just a buy in to record a score.
Equipment break down
1. Rower/Bike, Wall ball, DB, floor space.
2. BB, KB, Wall space
3. Pull up bar, BB, DB, for space.
4. Pull up bar, floor space, Wall space, weight plate.
5. Floor space, Wall space, DB.

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today prioritizes lower body, anterior delts, and core; accessory work targets posterior chain to balance and prevent imbalance.
